layout_system:
Preview frame: 1440 x 934 (data-props $preview), titled 'Org admin canvas'.

SHELL (.shell)
- display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr) var(--bar); grid-template-rows: auto auto; align-content: start; gap 20px; padding 20px; min-height 100vh; border-box. The dot-grid background is on the shell.
- --bar = clamp(57px, 5.13vw, 74px), i.e. 73.9px at 1440.
- Column 1, row 1: the context bar (.ctxbar, align-self start, position relative, not sticky; it scrolls away).
- Column 2, row 1: the widget grid (.dash).
- Column 3: an empty symmetric spacer that keeps the canvas centred.
- Row 2 (grid-column 1 / -1): the main bar, justify-self center, max-width 100%, flex-wrap wrap, justify-content center, position sticky, bottom 20px, so it floats 20px above the viewport bottom. Both bars have z-index 1.

WIDGET GRID (.dash)
- display grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-auto-rows: minmax(72px, auto); gap 20px; min-width 0. Placement is plain CSS auto-placement (sparse, in source order). There is no explicit row or column start, no dense packing and no stored coordinates.
- At 1440 the content column is 1440 − 40 − 2×73.9 − 40 = 1212px, so one column is 82.7px.
- Span classes (each widget also has an inline grid-column: span N and grid-row: span N):
  - c3 = 3 columns (288px)
  - c4 = 4 columns (391px)
  - c5 = 5 columns (493px)
  - c7 = 7 columns (699px)
  - c8 = 8 columns (801px)
- Row spans used: 2, 3, 4 and 5. Minimum heights at 72px rows and 20px gaps: span 2 = 164px, span 3 = 256px, span 4 = 348px, span 5 = 440px. Rows grow with content (minmax auto).

WIDGET SHELL (.w)
- section, flex column, min-width 0, min-height 0, position relative, overflow hidden, radius 12px, 1px hairline border, card surface.
- First child: the selection overlay. When selected it is an absolutely positioned div, inset 0, 2px solid #0E153E, radius 12px, pointer-events none.
- Then a full-width title-bar button: grip icon, title, optional right-aligned meta. It has a 1px bottom border.
- Then the body, flex: 1.

SNAPPING, DRAG, RESIZE
- Not implemented. The grip icon is decorative and the 'Resize' tool is inert.
- There is no free-cell or drop placeholder, and no lock state.
- Gaps left by auto-placement stay empty, for example 8 empty columns beside 'How mapping works' and 'Invite a member', and 7 beside 'Add a reward'.

BREAKPOINT max-width 1180px
- The shell drops the right spacer: columns become var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr).
- .dash becomes repeat(6, minmax(0,1fr)).
- .c7 and .c5 become span 6 (full width).
- .c4 and .c3 become span 3 (half width).
- .c8 is NOT remapped and keeps its inline span 8 in a 6-column grid, which creates implicit columns and overflow.
- Row spans are unchanged.

BREAKPOINT max-width 720px (phone)
- The shell becomes a single column, minmax(0,1fr).
- The context bar moves to row 1 as a horizontal strip: flex-direction row, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center, width auto. Its kicker/title block is flex 1 1 100% with no bottom border and no bottom margin. Each tool button is 4.3em wide.
- .dash moves to row 2 as one column; .c7, .c5, .c4 and .c3 become span 1. .c8 is again not handled.
- The main bar moves to row 3, justify-self stretch, gap 4px, still sticky and wrapping.
- .guide is defined as width calc(100vw − 40px) and max-height 45vh, but no guide is rendered on this board.
- This board has no phone action sheet.

Main-bar scale overrides, and the rendering defect they cause
- .mainbar>button.main forces width 4.9em (≈64px), height 3.7em and gap .15em on every button with class 'main'. That includes the five text page tabs, which then cannot fit their nowrap labels.
- The screenshot shows the result: the labels overlap and spill into each other ('Dashboar' clipped in the navy pill, then 'sers & crews', 'Report ingestion', 'Feedback coaching' and 'Rewards' stacked over each other).
- .mainbar>button.main>span[style*='position: absolute'] forces the badges to height .62em, top .46em and right 1.08em. With the inline min-width of 16px, each badge renders as a squat 16x8 red bar with the '3' clipped. The screenshot shows these red bars above 'Report ingestion' and 'Rewards'.
- .mainbar>a forces 3.4em x 3.4em on all anchors, including 'Crew app' and 'Console', overriding their inline 64x48.
Hover rules (.tool:hover and .main:hover set background oklch(0.975 0.006 275)) have no visible effect, because every tool and tab sets its background inline and the inline style wins.

interactions: Initial state: page = 'overview' (Dashboard), selected = 'none'. The context bar reads 'DASHBOARD / Nothing selected' with the tools 'Add', 'Arrange', 'Reset' and 'Lock'.

Select: every widget's full-width title bar is a button with aria-label 'Select widget: <Title>'. Clicking it calls pick_<key> and sets selected = key. Effects:
- A 2px #0E153E ring (radius 12px, pointer-events none) appears over that card.
- The context-bar kicker becomes 'Widget' and the title becomes the widget's title.
- The tool list switches to the widget's set, with its primary tool in red.
- 'Pin', 'Resize', 'Hide' and 'Esc' appear below a divider.
There is no animation or transition.
Re-select and switch: clicking another title bar moves the selection. Clicking the selected title again keeps it selected (no toggle-off). Only one widget can be selected at a time.

Deselect: the 'Esc' button (aria-label 'Deselect') calls clear(), which sets selected = 'none'. No keydown listener exists, so the physical Escape key does nothing, and clicking the empty canvas does not deselect either.

Page navigation: the main-bar tabs 'Dashboard', 'Users & crews', 'Report ingestion', 'Feedback coaching' and 'Rewards' call go_<page>. This sets page and resets selected to 'none'. Each page's widgets are wrapped in <sc-if pg_<page>>, so only one page's widgets render. The active tab turns navy with white text.

Inert controls: every context-bar tool (run: () => {}); 'Pin', 'Resize' and 'Hide'; the main-bar 'Add', 'Layout', 'Search' and 'Theme'; the account button; the CTAs 'Send invite', 'Upload', 'Generate guidance' and 'Publish'; the table text actions 'Edit', 'Approve' and 'Deliver'; and the drop zone. Form fields are uncontrolled native inputs and selects.
Links: the S3 logo goes to 'Admin.dc.html' (this board), 'Crew app' to 'Main.dc.html' and 'Console' to 'Super.dc.html'.

Drag, resize, arrange, lock, reset and add-from-library: not implemented on this board. They exist only as labels and icons ('Arrange', 'Lock', 'Reset', 'Add', 'Resize', the grip dots). There is no snapping and no placeholder.
Search: the main-bar 'Search' button and the footer copy '7 of 48 · search, or filter by team' imply search and team filtering, but no search UI exists.
Theme: the 'Theme' button (moon icon) exists, but there are no dark tokens and no handler.
Guide: no guide is implemented on this board. data-guide hooks exist on every widget and on 'ctxbar' and 'mainbar', and the .guide CSS exists.
Keyboard: all interactive elements are native buttons, links and inputs, so they are tab-focusable and Enter/Space activate them. No custom focus styles, roving focus or shortcuts are defined.
Hover: .tool:hover and .main:hover are declared but overridden by the inline backgrounds, so there is no visible hover feedback.
Sticky behaviour: the main bar is sticky at bottom 20px. The context bar is not sticky and scrolls with the page.
Scroll: tables scroll horizontally inside their card (overflow-x auto). Cells truncate with an ellipsis at max-width 260px.
guide_steps: No guide steps are defined on the org admin board. The script has no steps array, no Play / Next controls and no guide card markup.

Guide scaffolding present for future use:
- CSS comment: 'guide card: floats beside the explained element; never lower than 20px above the main bar'.
- A phone rule: @media (max-width:720px){.guide{width:calc(100vw - 40px) !important;max-height:45vh}}.

Available guide anchors (data-guide values), by page:
- Dashboard: members, reports, avgcredits, reflections, weekly, tiers, consents, needs, privacy
- Users & crews: userstable, teams, missing, invite
- Report ingestion: profiles, batch, ingestnote
- Feedback coaching: coachform, coachhow, coachlog
- Rewards: requests, catalog, addreward
- Chrome: ctxbar, mainbar

annotations: Board label in the six-board shell (template.html): 'Org admin · pages: Dashboard / Users / Ingestion / Coaching / Rewards'. The iframe is 1440x934.
Document <title>: 'Org admin canvas'. The bundle placeholder text is 'Loading Org admin canvas...'.
Sibling-board hint from the shell: the desktop board is labelled 'Desktop · canvas dashboard (click a widget title bar)'. The same selection model applies here.
CSS designer comment: 'guide card: floats beside the explained element; never lower than 20px above the main bar'.
CSS designer comment: 'toolbars scale by RATIO: one unit (1em = 13px at 1440 wide, clamped 10–13px) drives every size and gap'.

Screenshot page5.png (2160x1401 export of the Dashboard page) confirms several things:
- The KPI row, the weekly table and tier bars, and the three list widgets render as described.
- The context bar reads 'DASHBOARD / Nothing selecte d' with muted 'Add', 'Arrange', 'Reset' and 'Lock'.
- The main bar shows 'ORG ADMIN', with the page-tab labels visibly overlapping and the badges drawn as clipped red bars, then 'Add', 'Layout', 'Search', 'Theme', 'Crew app', 'Console' and the 'RA Ron Avital / Org admin · Skyline' account chip.
Sample organisation and persona: 'Skyline Airways' (short form 'Skyline'), email domain 'skyline.aero', anonymous token prefix 'SKY-', admin 'Ron Avital'.
open_questions: Breakpoint gap: the .c8 class (Weekly activity, Users & crews, Profiles in the wall) is not remapped in the ≤1180px or ≤720px rules. Its inline span 8 overflows the 6-column and 1-column grids, creating implicit columns. Should c8 map to span 6 and span 1 like c7?

Main-bar CSS defect: .mainbar>button.main{width:4.9em} also applies to the text page tabs, which overlap in the screenshot. The badge override also squashes the count badges to 8px tall. Should the tab and icon-button classes be split, the tabs move into a segmented control, or the tabs collapse into icons with labels?

The context title shows 'Users & crews' literally because the CTX string contains an HTML entity. The 'Browse' tool references I.search, which does not exist, so its icon is blank. Both are prototype bugs to fix during implementation.
Hover feedback is effectively absent: .tool:hover and .main:hover lose to the inline backgrounds. What hover and pressed styles are intended?
Escape key: the bar labels deselect as 'Esc', but no key handler exists. Clicking the canvas does not deselect either. Is keyboard Esc and click-outside deselection required?

Nothing on the canvas works yet: Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock, Pin, Resize, Hide, Layout, Search and Theme have no behaviour. Org admin layouts also need definitions for what is persisted and where (per user or per org), the widget library contents, the sizes allowed per widget, and the lock semantics.
No dark theme or accent tokens are defined on this board, although a Theme button is present. Should the dark values come from another board or from the existing app theme?

There are no page headers. The current app's PageHero descriptions and status chips (e.g. org name · N crew, Week N, Last 8 weeks) and the 'No organization attached' banners for super admins have no place in the canvas. Where do they go?

Drill-down / full-data views are not designed. Examples: 'Open users', 'Ingest', 'Rules', 'Trend', 'Review', 'Export CSV', '8 → 16 wk', 'Open' on coaching sessions, 'History', 'Edit' rows, member edit, and 'Missing reports' showing 2 of 7. Should each open a full page, a side sheet or an expanded (XL) widget?

Data inconsistencies in the sample data:
- 'Weekly activity' shows 5 rows but its footer says 'Last 8 weeks · total 412' (the visible rows sum to 259).
- 'Training-needs signal' is labelled 'sessions, 8 weeks', yet its numbers equal the 5 visible weeks.
- The Teams widget lists 'Cabin' while the users table shows 'Cabin · Team B'.
Totals rule change: the concept adds a 'Coaching' column to Weekly activity and includes it in Total. The current app deliberately excludes manager coaching from the total. Which rule wins?

Colour semantics differ from the current app:
- Tier dots: Bronze grey, Silver navy, Gold red, Platinum green; all bars navy.
- Sharing requests: Pending red, Declined grey. The current app uses Pending=warn and Declined=bad.
Confirm the new mapping.
'Reports loaded' is shown green only. Should it switch tone below a threshold, like the current 80% ok/warn rule?

Schema gaps (supabase/migrations):
- The 'Role' column values ('Captain', 'First officer', 'Pilot', 'Cabin manager') and 'Category' values ('Line pilot', 'Instructor', 'Cabin crew') do not match users.role (end_user/org_admin/super_admin) or users.operational_category (military_pilot, civilian_pilot, management, first_officer, captain, other).
- Teams are a free-text column, not entities, so 'New team' and 'Assign team' have nothing to act on.
- The 'since 12 Sep' date for missing reports has no source column.

'Invite a member' (Work email + Role with 'Crew member' / 'Org admin', 'Invites expire in 7 days') implies an invitation table and an email flow that do not exist. The current app creates accounts directly with a temporary password and collects Full name, Team / fleet, Category and Gender. Can an org admin create other org admins?

'Coaching guidance' fields differ from the current form ('Type of conversation', 'What happened / what do you want to address?', 'Your goal for the conversation'). The concept adds 'Tone you are aiming for' (Supportive / Direct / Developmental) and shows no result panel. Also undefined: where the generated guidance renders, and what drives the '14 employees eligible this month' count.

Rewards: 'Draft' implies a draft status, but organization_rewards has only is_active. 'Add a reward' omits the Description and Inventory fields the current modal has. The catalog shows 'Jumpseat day' as 0 left and 'Inactive': is inventory exhaustion meant to equal inactive? There is also no data source for '1,850 credits redeemed this quarter'.
Upload limits: the board says 'up to 10 files · 10 MB each', but the Netlify demo deployment caps uploads at 4 MB. Which limit should the UI state per environment?

Privacy wording: the 'Anonymity wall' says 'Everything on this dashboard is an aggregate'. Yet the Users, Coaching and Rewards pages show member names, which the current app also does. Should the copy be scoped to the Dashboard page only?

Phone: there is no phone board for org admin and no widget action sheet. At ≤720px the context bar just becomes a wrapping strip and the five-tab main bar wraps. Should org admin adopt the crew phone pattern (action sheet, condensed tabs)?
The 'Console' link should presumably appear only for super admins, as the current admin layout does. The prototype always shows it.
Empty, loading, error and permission states (no org attached, RPC failure, no sessions yet, upload progress or failure, generation in progress) are not designed for any widget.
